sentences.text: Learned A.G.A. submits that notice of the instant application has been served upon the informant/opposite party no. 2 and opposite party no. 4/Child Welfare Committee, Firozabad on 25.11.2024.
The receiving endorsements produced by the learned A.G.A. are taken on record.
However, no one appears on behalf of the said opposite parties nor any counter affidavit has been filed on their behalf.

2. Heard counsel for the applicant, Sri Abhishek Srivastava, counsel for the informant and Sri Rupak Chaubey, learned A.G.A. for the State- opposite party, and perused the material placed on record.
3.

This application under Section 438 Cr.P.C. has been filed seeking anticipatory bail in Case Crime No. 186 of 2022, under Sections 376, 323, 504, 506 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of POCSO Act, Police Station Khairgarh, District Firozabad.

sentences.text: 4. Counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the instant case.
The applicant and the victim were in consensual relationship since several years.
As per the statements of the victim under Section 161 Cr.P.C. and 164 Cr.P.C., the victim was major.

The consensual sexual relationship which if continued between the parties for quite a long time could not be said to have continued under the 'misconception of fact' under Section 90 I.P.C. and could not be said to be 'rape' under Section 375 I.P.C.

Further, during the pendency of the investigation,
the applicant was granted protection till submission of Police report by this court vide order dated 01.12.2022 passed in Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. 18409 of 2022 (Rahul Yadav vs. State of U.P.
and 2 others).

entities.text:

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The applicant has no criminal antecedents.
Investigation has been completed.
The applicant had cooperated in the investigation.
Charge-sheet has been filed.
No custodial interrogation is required.
The applicant has been summoned by the concerned court.

It is next submitted that the applicant has apprehension of his arrest and in case, the applicant is released on anticipatory bail, he will not misuse the said liberty.
5.
Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail but could not satisfactorily dispute the aforesaid submissions from the record.

6. Having regard to the submissions made by counsel for the applicant, considering the nature of accusations, antecedents of the applicant, and, in particular, the fact that the applicant and the victim were in consensual relationship for a considerable period of time and as per the statement of the victim, she was major and the fact that during the course of investigation, the applicant was granted protection till submission of Police report by this Court.
The applicant had cooperated in the investigation and no custodial interrogation is required.

Further, no violation of conditions or misuse of liberty of anticipatory bail has been pointed out by the learned A.G.A., without commenting on merits of the case, I am of the opinion that the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on anticipatory bail.
8. In default of any of the conditions, the court concerned is at liberty to pass appropriate orders for enforcing and compelling the same.
